basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old graphic designer living in Portland, Oregon. I recently joined Reddit to explore diverse perspectives and engage in communities that resonate with my personal experiences. I'm passionate about art and creativity, and I often find myself dabbling in various DIY projects during my free time. Although I'm currently single, I have a close-knit group of friends who are supportive and share similar interests. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have been working in the graphic design industry for the past 5 years. My interest in understanding human relationships and psychology has led me to explore various discussion threads on Reddit. Most of my knowledge is self-taught through online courses and personal research.
